lines.text: 아주 먼 옛날, 엄마 염소와 일곱 마리 아기 염소가 살았어요.
lines.en: Long, long ago, a mother goat and seven little kids lived together.
segs: Long, long ago, a mother goat and seven little kids lived together.

lines.text: 어느 날, 엄마 염소가 바구니를 들고 말했어요.
lines.en: One day, Mother Goat picked up a basket and said,
segs: One day, Mother Goat picked up a basket and said,

lines.text: "엄마는 풀을 뜯으러 다녀올게. 늑대가 오면 문을 열어 주면 안 돼!"
lines.en: I'm going out to eat some grass. Don't open the door if the wolf comes!
segs: I'm going out to eat some grass. Don't open the door if the wolf comes!

lines.text: "늑대는 목소리가 걸걸하고, 발이 시커멓단다. 꼭 기억해!"
lines.en: The wolf has a rough voice and black paws. Remember!
segs: The wolf has a rough voice and black paws. Remember!

lines.text: "네, 엄마!" 아기 염소들이 큰 소리로 대답했어요.
lines.en: Yes, Mother! The little goats answered in loud voices.
segs: The little goats answered in loud voices.

lines.text: 엄마가 가고 얼마 뒤, 문밖에서 소리가 났어요.
lines.en: Soon after Mother left, there was a sound outside the door.
segs: Soon after Mother left, there was a sound outside the door.

lines.text: "얘들아, 엄마야. 문 열어 줘!" 걸걸한 목소리였어요.
lines.en: Children, it's Mother. Open the door! It was a rough voice.
segs: Children, it's Mother. Open the door!

lines.text: 아기 염소들이 서로 쳐다보았어요.
lines.en: The little goats looked at each other.
segs: The little goats looked at each other.

lines.text: "목소리가 걸걸해. 우리 엄마가 아니야!" 첫째가 말했어요.
lines.en: That voice is rough. You're not our mother! said the oldest kid.
segs: That voice is rough. You're not our mother!

lines.text: "저리 가요, 늑대!" 아기 염소들이 소리쳤어요.
lines.en: Go away, wolf! the little goats shouted.

lines.text: 늑대는 곰곰이 생각했어요.
lines.en: The wolf thought hard.

lines.text: "목소리를 곱게 만들어야지. 분필을 먹어 볼까?"
lines.en: I need a sweet voice. Shall I eat some chalk?
segs: I need a sweet voice. Shall I eat some chalk?

lines.text: 늑대의 목소리가 가늘고 고와졌어요.
lines.en: The wolf's voice became thin and sweet.
segs: The wolf's voice became thin and sweet.

lines.text: "얘들아, 엄마야. 문 열어 줘~"
lines.en: Children, it's Mother. Open the door, please~
segs: Children, it's Mother. Open the door, please~

lines.text: "그럼 문틈으로 발을 보여 주세요!" 아기 염소들이 말했어요.
lines.en: Then show us your paw through the crack! said the little goats.
segs: Then show us your paw through the crack!

lines.text: 늑대는 밀가루를 발에 묻혀서, 하얀 발을 쑥 내밀었어요.
lines.en: The wolf dipped his paw in flour and stuck out a white paw.
segs: The wolf dipped his paw in flour and stuck out a white paw.

lines.text: "에취!" 늑대가 밀가루 재채기를 했어요.
lines.en: Achoo! The wolf sneezed flour.

lines.text: "어? 하얀 발이야! 엄마다!" 아기 염소들은 깜빡 속아서 문을 열었어요.
lines.en: Oh? A white paw! It's Mother! The little goats were fooled and opened the door.
segs: Oh? A white paw! It's Mother!
The little goats were fooled and opened the door.

lines.text: 그런데 들어온 건 엄마가 아니라 늑대였어요!
lines.en: But it was not Mother who came in. It was the wolf!
segs: But it was not Mother who came in. It was the wolf!

lines.text: "숨자, 숨자!" 아기 염소들이 이불 속, 빨래 바구니 속으로 쏙쏙 숨었어요.
lines.en: Hide, hide! The little goats hid in the blankets and in the laundry basket, pop, pop.
segs: The little goats hid in the blankets and in the laundry basket, pop, pop.

lines.text: 막내는 어디에 숨을까요?
lines.en: Where will the youngest hide?

lines.text: 막내는 키 큰 시계 속에 쏙 숨었어요. 아무도 몰랐어요.
lines.en: The youngest hid inside the tall clock. Nobody knew.
segs: The youngest hid inside the tall clock. Nobody knew.

lines.text: "어디 숨었나? 다 찾아낼 테다!" 늑대가 집 안을 뒤졌어요.
lines.en: Where did you hide? I'll find every one of you! The wolf searched the house.
segs: Where did you hide? I'll find every one of you!

lines.text: 늑대는 시계 속만 빼고, 아기 염소들을 모두 찾아내서 꿀꺽 삼켜 버렸어요.
lines.en: The wolf found all the little goats except the one in the clock, and gulped them down.
segs: The wolf found all the little goats except the one in the clock, and gulped them down.

lines.text: 하지만 아기 염소들은 다치지 않았어요. 아주 따뜻하고 포근한 뱃속이었거든요.
lines.en: But the little goats were not hurt. It was warm and cozy inside his tummy.
segs: But the little goats were not hurt. It was warm and cozy inside his tummy.

lines.text: 집에 돌아온 엄마 염소는 깜짝 놀랐어요.
lines.en: Mother Goat came home and was very surprised.
segs: Mother Goat came home and was very surprised.

lines.text: "얘들아, 어디 있니? 엄마 왔어!"
lines.en: Children, where are you? Mother is home!
segs: Children, where are you? Mother is home!

lines.text: "엄마!" 막내가 시계 속에서 폴짝 나왔어요.
lines.en: Mother! The youngest hopped out of the clock.
segs: The youngest hopped out of the clock.

lines.text: "늑대가 형들과 누나들을 꿀꺽 삼켰어요!"
lines.en: The wolf gulped down my brothers and sisters!
segs: The wolf gulped down my brothers and sisters!

lines.text: "걱정 마. 엄마가 꼭 구해 줄게!" 엄마는 가위와 바늘을 챙겼어요.
lines.en: Don't worry. Mother will save them! Mother took her scissors and needle.
segs: Don't worry. Mother will save them!
Mother took her scissors and needle.

lines.text: 늑대는 배가 불러서, 나무 아래에서 쿨쿨 자고 있었어요.
lines.en: The wolf was full, and he was fast asleep under a tree.
segs: The wolf was full, and he was fast asleep under a tree.

lines.text: 엄마와 막내는 살금살금 다가갔어요.
lines.en: Mother and the youngest tiptoed closer.
segs: Mother and the youngest tiptoed closer.

lines.text: "쉿! 늑대가 깨지 않게, 그림자 극장에서 아기들을 꺼내 줄게."
lines.en: Shh! So the wolf won't wake up, I'll bring the little ones out at the shadow theater.
segs: Shh! So the wolf won't wake up, I'll bring the little ones out at the shadow theater.

lines.text: 하얀 종이 극장에 엄마의 그림자가 나타났어요.
lines.en: Mother's shadow appeared in the white paper theater.
segs: Mother's shadow appeared in the white paper theater.

lines.text: 슥삭슥삭, 가위질을 하자 아기 염소들이 하나씩 나와요!
lines.en: Snip, snip! With each cut, the little goats came out one by one!
segs: Snip, snip! With each cut, the little goats came out one by one!

lines.text: "엄마!" 아기 염소 여섯 마리가 모두 무사히 나왔어요.
lines.en: Mother! All six little goats came out safe and sound.
segs: All six little goats came out safe and sound.

lines.text: "이제 늑대 배에 돌멩이를 넣어 주자."
lines.en: Now let's put stones in the wolf's tummy.
segs: Now let's put stones in the wolf's tummy.

lines.text: 엄마가 바늘로 콕콕콕 꿰맸어요. 늑대는 아무것도 몰랐어요.
lines.en: Mother stitched with her needle, poke, poke, poke. The wolf did not notice a thing.
segs: Mother stitched with her needle, poke, poke, poke. The wolf did not notice a thing.

lines.text: 잠에서 깬 늑대가 비틀비틀 일어났어요.
lines.en: The wolf woke up and stumbled to his feet.
segs: The wolf woke up and stumbled to his feet.

lines.text: "아이고, 배가 무거워. 목이 말라!"
lines.en: Oh dear, my tummy is so heavy. I'm thirsty!
segs: Oh dear, my tummy is so heavy. I'm thirsty!

lines.text: "우물에서 물을 마셔야지."
lines.en: I must drink water from the well.
segs: I must drink water from the well.

lines.text: 풍덩! 늑대가 우물에 빠졌어요.
lines.en: Splash! The wolf fell into the well.
segs: Splash! The wolf fell into the well.

lines.text: "으악, 차가워! 다시는 안 올 거야!"
lines.en: Yikes, it's cold! I'm never coming back!
segs: Yikes, it's cold! I'm never coming back!

lines.text: 늑대는 흠뻑 젖은 채 멀리멀리 도망갔어요.
lines.en: The wolf ran far, far away, dripping wet.
segs: The wolf ran far, far away, dripping wet.

lines.text: 엄마와 일곱 아기 염소는 손을 잡고 신나게 춤을 추었어요.
lines.en: Mother and the seven little goats held hands and danced happily.
segs: Mother and the seven little goats held hands and danced happily.

lines.text: 아기 염소들을 톡톡 눌러 같이 춤춰 봐요!
lines.en: Tap, tap the little goats to dance together!
segs: Tap, tap the little goats to dance together!

lines.text: 엄마 목소리를 잘 아는 아기 염소들은 오래오래 행복하게 살았답니다.
lines.en: The little goats who knew Mother's voice well lived happily for a long, long time.
segs: The little goats who knew Mother's voice well lived happily for a long, long time.

lines.text: 엄마 염소를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Mother Goat!

lines.text: 첫째 염소를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the oldest goat!

lines.text: 늑대를 톡톡톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the wolf!

lines.text: 늑대를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the wolf!

lines.text: 막내 염소를 톡 눌러서 시계 속에 숨겨 줘요!
lines.en: Tap the youngest goat to hide him in the clock!

lines.text: 시계를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the clock!

lines.text: 엄마 염소를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Mother Goat!

lines.text: 화면을 톡톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap, tap the screen!

lines.text: 돌멩이를 톡톡톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the stones!

lines.text: 늑대를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the wolf!

ui.늑대와 일곱 마리 아기 염소: The Wolf and the Seven Kids
